title: Upcoming Pilgrimage Theatre concert with Nellie Lutcher
summary: Thompson will play half a concert with Nellie Lutcher on June 1 at Hollywood's Pilgrimage Theatre, with bassist Larry Gale and drummer Jimmie Smith.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Speaking of your career, I understand you have a concert coming up in June. Is it in June or is it in July?
I'm playing a concert at the Pilgrimage Theatre here in Hollywood, June the 1st from 2:00 o'clock p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Well, actually I'm sharing a bill with Nellie Luther. Do you remember her?

And the fact of the matter is it was through her kindness, and through an act of kindness of the musician's union that this was arranged for me as a means of my getting back into music after my operation, and being heard and seen again. And so I'm sharing the bill with Nellie Lutcher. She will play half of the concert and I will play the other half of the concert.
Yes. And I wish you could be here for that.
I wish I could too! What -- have you thought out what kind of a program you'll present?

Yes, I'm preparing the material now. I have two fine musicians who are going to work with me. Larry Gale on the bass and Jimmie Smith on the drums. These are very capable, local musicians here in Hollywood who I became to know since I've been back here. And I'm looking forward to it. I have the material in the making now, and I'm looking forward to getting it properly organized. And if you can I'd like to have you as my guest on that day.
If I can be here I would thoroughly enjoy it, I certainly would. I hope that there will be good press release and they probably will see to it, because that's always very important, isn't it?
Well yes, it is. I guess to the public

and to the commercial world, but I'm hoping that the music will be good, and I'm hoping that I enjoy playing and I hope the people enjoy what I'm doing. And to me as I said it will be an honor and a blessing just to be able to sit at the piano again and play after what I've gone through and what I've been lucky enough to recuperate from.
